Delapan Tersangka Telah Ditahan hingga Juli 2026

Dalam perkembangan sebelumnya, hingga 28 Juli 2026, KPK telah menahan delapan dari 20 tersangka dalam perkara korupsi dana hibah Jatim tersebut.

Empat tersangka, yakni Wawan Kristiawan, Sukar, Hasanuddin, dan Jodi Pradana Putra, masuk dalam klaster dugaan suap terhadap Kusnadi.

Sementara itu, empat tersangka lainnya, yakni Achmad Yahya, M. Fathullah, Ra Wahid Ruslan, dan Moch. Mahrus, masuk dalam klaster dugaan suap terhadap AS dan BW.

Dari delapan tersangka yang telah ditahan tersebut, empat orang telah divonis bersalah oleh majelis hakim. Adapun empat tersangka lainnya masih menjalani proses persidangan. (*)

Kemenangan telak 5-0 Timnas Jerman atas Belanda di UEFA Nations League , Senin (16/11/2026) atau Selasa dini hari WIB bukan sekadar menjadi penegasan kebangkitan Die Mannschaft di bawah Jurgen Klopp. Pertandingan di Olympiastadion Berlin itu sekaligus menandai berakhirnya salah satu kemitraan paling bersejarah dalam sepak bola dunia: hubungan Jerman dengan Adidas yang telah berlangsung lebih dari 70 tahun.

Mulai 2027, perusahaan perlengkapan olahraga asal Amerika Serikat, Nike , akan mengambil alih posisi Adidas sebagai pemasok apparel resmi tim nasional Jerman.

Pergantian tersebut menjadi babak baru bagi sepak bola Jerman. Selama lebih dari tujuh dekade, Adidas bukan hanya menyediakan seragam pertandingan, tetapi juga menjadi bagian dari perjalanan sejarah dan kesuksesan tim nasional negara tersebut.

Kemenangan atas Belanda Jadi Penampilan Terakhir Bersama Adidas

Pertandingan melawan Belanda menjadi momen terakhir tim nasional putra Jerman mengenakan perlengkapan Adidas dalam pertandingan internasional.

Pelatih Jurgen Klopp pun masih terlihat menggunakan topi khas Adidas berwarna Jerman dengan tulisan One of 83 million , yang merujuk pada jumlah penduduk negara tersebut.

Dalam penampilan berikutnya, Klopp kemungkinan harus mengganti atribut yang selama ini menjadi bagian dari penampilannya di pinggir lapangan.

Momen perpisahan itu terasa semakin istimewa karena Jerman menutup kerja sama panjang tersebut dengan kemenangan besar. Florian Wirtz dan rekan-rekannya menghancurkan Belanda 5-0 sekaligus memastikan tiket ke perempat final UEFA Nations League.

Nike Menang karena Tawaran Finansial

Keputusan mengganti Adidas dengan Nike sebenarnya telah diumumkan Federasi Sepak Bola Jerman (DFB) pada Maret 2024.

Pengumuman tersebut sempat mengejutkan publik dan memunculkan kritik. Sebab, Adidas selama puluhan tahun identik dengan identitas sepak bola Jerman.

DFB kemudian memberikan penjelasan mengenai keputusan tersebut. Faktor finansial menjadi pertimbangan utama dalam menentukan mitra apparel berikutnya.

"Nike memberikan penawaran finansial terbaik dengan selisih yang jauh dalam proses tender yang transparan dan nondiskriminatif," demikian pernyataan DFB ketika mengumumkan kesepakatan tersebut.

Kontrak Nike dengan DFB akan berlangsung hingga 2034. Kesepakatan ini menandai perubahan besar dalam strategi komersial federasi sepak bola Jerman, sekaligus memperlihatkan besarnya nilai bisnis di balik industri olahraga profesional.

Sejarah Adidas dan Sepak Bola Jerman Sejak Piala Dunia 1954

Hubungan Adidas dengan sepak bola Jerman memiliki akar sejarah yang kuat. Kemitraan tersebut bermula pada Piala Dunia 1954, ketika pendiri Adidas, Adi Dassler, mendampingi pelatih Jerman Barat Sepp Herberger di bangku cadangan.

Saat itu, tim Jerman Barat menggunakan sepatu sepak bola dengan pul atau stud yang dapat dilepas-pasang. Teknologi tersebut membantu para pemain menghadapi kondisi lapangan yang basah ketika berhadapan dengan Hungaria di partai final.

Jerman Barat akhirnya memenangkan pertandingan tersebut dan meraih gelar Piala Dunia pertamanya.

Namun, terdapat catatan sejarah menarik mengenai teknologi sepatu tersebut. Adi Dassler bukan penemu pertama konsep pul yang dapat diganti seperti yang selama ini kerap diyakini.

Ide tersebut sebenarnya berasal dari pembuat sepatu asal Jerman, Alexander Salot, yang mendaftarkan temuannya ke kantor paten Jerman pada 30 Agustus 1949.

Meski demikian, penggunaan sepatu Adidas dalam kemenangan Jerman Barat pada Piala Dunia 1954 menjadi salah satu tonggak penting dalam sejarah perkembangan perusahaan tersebut.

Sejak saat itu, Adidas terus memasok perlengkapan sepak bola tim nasional Jerman.

Adidas Menemani Empat Gelar Piala Dunia Putra

Selama menjalin kerja sama dengan Adidas, tim nasional Jerman mencatat sejumlah pencapaian terbesar dalam sejarah sepak bola internasional.

Jerman Barat dan Jerman setelah reunifikasi berhasil meraih empat gelar Piala Dunia putra, yakni pada 1954, 1974, 1990, dan 2014.

Adidas menjadi bagian dari perjalanan keempat generasi juara tersebut.

Kisah keberhasilan serupa juga terjadi pada tim nasional putri Jerman. Mereka mengenakan perlengkapan Adidas ketika meraih dua gelar Piala Dunia pada 2003 dan 2007.

Dengan catatan tersebut, berakhirnya kemitraan Adidas dan DFB bukan sekadar pergantian produsen seragam. Perubahan ini juga menutup satu babak panjang yang melekat pada identitas dan prestasi sepak bola Jerman.

Mulai 2027, Nike akan melanjutkan peran tersebut. Tantangannya bukan hanya menyediakan perlengkapan pertandingan, tetapi juga membangun hubungan baru dengan identitas sepak bola Jerman yang selama puluhan tahun telah lekat dengan tiga garis khas Adidas. (*)

Timnas Jerman menunjukkan sinyal kuat kebangkitan sepak bola mereka. Kemenangan telak 5-0 atas Belanda dalam lanjutan UEFA Nations League di Berlin, Senin (16/11/2026) atau Selasa dini hari waktu Indonesia, menjadi bukti bahwa proyek pembaruan Die Mannschaft di bawah pelatih Jurgen Klopp mulai menunjukkan hasil menjanjikan.

Hasil tersebut sekaligus memastikan Jerman melangkah ke perempat final UEFA Nations League. Lebih dari sekadar kemenangan besar, performa impresif ini memperlihatkan perkembangan signifikan tim yang tengah membangun kembali kekuatannya dengan mengandalkan generasi pemain muda.

Florian Wirtz menjadi bintang pertandingan setelah mencetak dua gol. Sementara tiga gol lainnya disumbangkan Derry Scherhant, Nico Schlotterbeck, dan Brajan Gruda.

Menariknya, tidak ada pencetak gol Jerman dalam pertandingan tersebut yang berusia di atas 26 tahun. Schlotterbeck menjadi pemain tertua dengan usia 26 tahun, sedangkan Wirtz baru berusia 23 tahun.

Scherhant, 24 tahun, membuka keunggulan Jerman. Adapun Gruda, yang baru berusia 22 tahun, mencetak satu gol sekaligus menyumbangkan dua assist. Penampilan tersebut terasa istimewa karena merupakan pertandingan keduanya bersama tim nasional senior Jerman.

Sebelumnya, Gruda juga mencetak gol dalam kemenangan 3-1 Jerman atas Serbia pada Jumat (13/11/2026).

Jurgen Klopp Bangun Optimisme Baru Jerman

Kemenangan atas Belanda mempertegas perubahan atmosfer di tubuh tim nasional Jerman sejak Klopp mengambil alih kursi kepelatihan.

Dalam enam pertandingan bersama Klopp, perkembangan permainan Jerman mulai terlihat. Kombinasi pemain muda, intensitas permainan, dan produktivitas gol menjadi sejumlah indikator kebangkitan mereka.

Klopp mengaku puas bukan hanya dengan hasil pertandingan, melainkan juga etos kerja yang diperlihatkan para pemain sepanjang laga.

"Semua orang yang hadir di sini hari ini pulang dengan senyuman. Mereka juga tidak akan mempertanyakan tim nasional Jerman selama tiga atau empat bulan ke depan. Itu hal yang bagus," ujar Klopp sekaligus menyinggung suasana negatif yang sebelumnya menyelimuti tim nasional Jerman.

Menurut Klopp, perkembangan para pemain membuat masa depan tim nasional kembali terlihat menjanjikan.

"Ketika memikirkan tim Jerman, orang bisa berkata, wow, tim ini berpotensi berkembang menjadi sesuatu yang besar. Dan itu bagus," katanya.

Florian Wirtz dan Generasi Muda Jadi Pembeda

Dominasi Jerman terlihat sejak babak pertama. Scherhant bahkan dua kali membentur tiang sebelum akhirnya memecah kebuntuan menjelang turun minum.

Pemain yang kini memperkuat Freiburg tersebut menunjukkan kualitas individu melalui gol pembuka yang spektakuler. Ia menusuk dari sisi permainan, melewati kapten Belanda Denzel Dumfries, kemudian melepaskan tembakan akurat ke sudut kanan atas gawang.

Kiper Belanda Bart Verbruggen sempat menyentuh bola, tetapi gagal menghentikannya.

Bagi Scherhant, gol tersebut terasa istimewa karena ia pernah mencetak gol di stadion yang sama ketika masih memperkuat Hertha Berlin.

"Anda tidak pernah membayangkan semuanya bisa berjalan lebih baik dari ini," ujar Scherhant.

Memasuki babak kedua, Jerman semakin tidak terbendung. Wirtz menggandakan keunggulan pada menit ke-60 melalui aksi individu yang memperlihatkan kualitas teknik dan ketenangannya.

Ia merebut kembali bola dari Dumfries setelah serangan Jerman terhenti, mengecoh lawan, kemudian melepaskan tembakan kaki kiri dari luar kotak penalti. Bola meluncur masuk setelah membentur tiang kiri gawang.

Lima menit berselang, Schlotterbeck memperbesar keunggulan menjadi 3-0 melalui sundulan rendah menyambut tendangan bebas Gruda.

Wirtz kemudian mencetak gol keduanya pada menit ke-71. Ia menyelesaikan umpan Gruda yang mendapat ruang bebas di sisi kanan.

Gol kelima Jerman lahir pada menit ke-77 melalui Gruda. Kiper Belanda Verbruggen bahkan terlihat frustrasi dan mengumpulkan rekan-rekannya untuk membicarakan situasi tim. Namun, semuanya sudah terlambat untuk menghindari kekalahan telak.

Jerman dan Belanda Lolos ke Perempat Final

Di pertandingan lain Grup A2, Yunani mengalahkan Serbia 1-0 melalui gol Giorgos Masouras pada menit ke-69.

Namun, kemenangan tersebut tidak cukup untuk membawa Yunani melangkah lebih jauh. Jerman dan Belanda tetap mengamankan tempat di perempat final dan menantikan undian yang dijadwalkan berlangsung Jumat.

Ketiga tim di grup tersebut sama-sama mengakhiri fase dengan koleksi 11 poin, tetapi Jerman dan Belanda memastikan posisi untuk melanjutkan kompetisi.

Swiss Tutup Fase Grup dengan Kemenangan Telak

Dari Grup B1, Swiss mengakhiri pertandingan dengan kemenangan meyakinkan 4-0 atas Skotlandia di St. Gallen.

Swiss sebenarnya sudah memastikan promosi ke League A setelah menjadi juara Grup B1. Kemenangan atas Skotlandia semakin melengkapi pencapaian tersebut.

Gol pertama Swiss tercipta melalui gol bunuh diri Lewis Ferguson pada menit ke-22. Gelandang Skotlandia itu bermaksud memotong umpan silang Zachary Athekame, tetapi justru mengarahkan bola ke gawang sendiri.

Setelah jeda, Winsley Boteli dan Alvyn Sanches mencetak gol perdana mereka untuk tim nasional Swiss. Zeki Amdouni kemudian melengkapi kemenangan 4-0.

Pada pertandingan lainnya, Slovenia menang 3-0 atas Makedonia Utara.

Sejumlah hasil lain juga mewarnai penutupan pertandingan UEFA Nations League. Kepulauan Faroe mengalahkan Moldova 1-0, Estonia menundukkan Bulgaria 2-1, Lituania menang 2-1 atas Liechtenstein, dan Islandia mengalahkan Luksemburg 3-0.

Sementara itu, Kazakhstan bermain imbang 2-2 dengan Slovakia, sedangkan Gibraltar dan Malta berbagi angka setelah bermain 1-1.

Kemenangan 5-0 atas Belanda menjadi salah satu hasil paling mencolok dalam rangkaian pertandingan tersebut. Bagi Jerman, hasil ini bukan sekadar tiket menuju perempat final, tetapi juga modal penting untuk membangun kembali kepercayaan publik terhadap masa depan Die Mannschaft.

Pertandingan tersebut sekaligus menjadi penampilan terakhir tim nasional putra Jerman menggunakan perlengkapan Adidas sebelum beralih ke Nike.

Pagi hari semestinya menjadi waktu untuk mempersiapkan diri sebelum menjalani berbagai aktivitas. Namun, tanpa disadari, sejumlah kebiasaan setelah bangun tidur justru bisa membuat seseorang lebih mudah merasa tertekan.

Alih-alih memulai hari dengan tenang, sebagian orang langsung memeriksa ponsel, terburu-buru menyiapkan kebutuhan, atau berulang kali menekan tombol tunda alarm. Kebiasaan sederhana ini ternyata dapat memengaruhi suasana hati dan meningkatkan stres sejak pagi.

Mengutip dari laporan Real Simple , menyebutkan ada tiga kebiasaan pagi yang perlu diperhatikan karena berpotensi membuat seseorang memulai hari dalam kondisi terburu-buru dan kewalahan.

1. Langsung Memeriksa Ponsel Setelah Bangun

Bagi banyak orang, memeriksa ponsel sudah menjadi bagian dari rutinitas begitu mata terbuka. Notifikasi pesan, email, berita, hingga media sosial seolah menjadi hal pertama yang harus diperiksa.

Namun, kebiasaan tersebut dapat membuat pikiran langsung dipenuhi berbagai tuntutan. Seseorang belum sempat sepenuhnya sadar dan mempersiapkan diri, tetapi sudah dihadapkan pada pesan yang perlu dibalas atau informasi yang menuntut perhatian.

Konselor kesehatan mental berlisensi di Miami, Mindy DeSeta, menjelaskan bahwa kebiasaan memeriksa ponsel segera setelah bangun dapat membuat seseorang lebih cepat masuk ke kondisi stres.

Ia menyarankan agar penggunaan ponsel ditunda setidaknya selama 30 menit setelah bangun tidur. Salah satu caranya adalah mengisi daya ponsel jauh dari tempat tidur atau menggunakan jam alarm biasa.

2. Tidak Memiliki Rutinitas Pagi yang Jelas

Pagi yang dipenuhi keputusan mendadak juga bisa menjadi sumber tekanan. Tanpa urutan kegiatan yang terencana, seseorang harus terus memikirkan apa yang perlu dilakukan berikutnya.

Terapis berlisensi Christine Hathaway mengatakan kondisi tersebut dapat membuat seseorang merasa kewalahan, melupakan keperluan penting, melewatkan sarapan, hingga terburu-buru meninggalkan rumah.

Rutinitas sederhana dapat membantu mengurangi ketidakpastian. Misalnya, menentukan urutan mandi, sarapan, berpakaian, dan menyiapkan perlengkapan sebelum berangkat.

Menyiapkan pakaian atau merencanakan menu sarapan sejak malam sebelumnya juga bisa membuat pagi lebih efisien. Meski begitu, tetap sediakan waktu tambahan untuk menghadapi hal-hal tak terduga.

3. Terlalu Sering Menekan Tombol Tunda Alarm

Keinginan tidur beberapa menit lebih lama setelah alarm berbunyi memang sulit dihindari. Namun, kebiasaan berulang kali menekan tombol snooze justru dapat membuat pagi semakin kacau.

Menurut DeSeta, kebiasaan tersebut bisa membuat seseorang merasa lebih mengantuk dan lesu. Waktu persiapan juga semakin berkurang sehingga aktivitas pagi terasa terburu-buru.

Untuk mengatasinya, atur alarm sesuai waktu yang benar-benar dibutuhkan untuk bangun. Meletakkan alarm di seberang ruangan juga dapat membantu karena seseorang harus berdiri untuk mematikannya.

Selain itu, pastikan kebutuhan tidur malam terpenuhi. Orang dewasa umumnya disarankan tidur sekitar tujuh hingga delapan jam setiap malam.

Mulai Pagi dengan Kebiasaan yang Lebih Sehat

Memulai hari dengan tenang tidak selalu membutuhkan perubahan besar. Menunda membuka ponsel, menyusun rutinitas sederhana, dan bangun ketika alarm berbunyi bisa menjadi langkah awal.

Kuncinya adalah mengurangi hal-hal yang membuat pikiran terbebani sejak pagi. Dengan persiapan yang lebih baik, seseorang memiliki kesempatan lebih besar menjalani aktivitas harian tanpa tekanan yang tidak perlu. (*)

Gerakan Nurani Bangsa ( GNB ) meminta pemerintah tetap memprioritaskan kebutuhan dasar warga di tengah proses pengisian jabatan Wakil Presiden RI. Seruan itu menjadi satu dari delapan pesan kebangsaan yang ditujukan kepada penyelenggara negara dan aparat penegak hukum.

Pesan Kebangsaan GNB itu bertanggal Senin (16/11/2026). Alissa Q. Wahid tercantum sebagai salah satu penandatangan sekaligus narahubung.

“Memastikan pemenuhan kebutuhan dasar warga dan penyelesaian persoalan ekonomi, pendidikan, kesehatan, hukum, tata kelola pemerintahan, dan lingkungan hidup tetap menjadi prioritas utama,” jelas Alissa Wahid dari GNB dalam keterangan tertulisnya.

Pernyataan itu disampaikan empat hari setelah Gibran Rakabuming Raka menyerahkan surat pengunduran diri dari jabatan wakil presiden kepada Presiden Prabowo Subianto dan pimpinan MPR pada Kamis (12/11/2026). Dalam dokumen tersebut, GNB juga menyinggung putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi (MK) dan Mahkamah Agung (MA) yang mendahului pengunduran diri itu.

Penanganan Kebakaran Hutan dan Kesehatan Warga

GNB meminta pemerintah mengoptimalkan anggaran dan sumber daya untuk mempercepat penanganan kebakaran hutan di berbagai wilayah serta memulihkan kawasan terdampak. Pemerintah juga diminta mencegah alih fungsi hutan semata-mata untuk kepentingan ekonomi.

Pemulihan kesehatan warga terdampak asap turut menjadi perhatian. GNB mendesak pemerintah segera menangani infeksi saluran pernapasan akut (ISPA), terutama pada anak-anak, warga lanjut usia, dan kelompok rentan lainnya.

Dugaan Penyadapan dan Perlindungan Hak Warga

Dalam penanganan unjuk rasa mahasiswa dan warga, GNB meminta aparat menghormati kebebasan berpendapat dan hak asasi manusia serta menghindari penggunaan kekuatan berlebihan. GNB juga menyerukan penghentian ujaran yang merendahkan, menstigma, atau mengintimidasi kalangan intelektual dan warga yang mengkritik kebijakan di ruang publik.

GNB mendesak penegak hukum mengusut dugaan penyadapan ilegal terhadap pejabat negara, aktivis, tokoh politik, dan warga yang menyampaikan kritik. Proses hukum diminta berjalan adil dan transparan, dengan hukuman setimpal bagi pihak yang terbukti bersalah serta perlindungan dan pemulihan hak bagi korban.

Gerakan tersebut juga meminta pemerintah menjunjung supremasi sipil dan mencegah pengerahan kekuatan militer di ranah sipil, terutama di lingkungan perguruan tinggi.

Untuk Papua, GNB mendorong penyelesaian krisis kemanusiaan melalui dialog yang menghormati martabat warga. Pemerintah juga diminta menjamin perlindungan hak masyarakat, termasuk warga yang mengungsi akibat konflik dan kekerasan.

Selain Alissa, pesan kebangsaan tersebut turut ditandatangani sejumlah tokoh lintas agama dan masyarakat, antara lain Nyai Sinta Nuriyah Abdurrahman Wahid, M. Quraish Shihab, KH Mustofa Bisri, Kardinal Ignatius Suharyo, Bhante Sri Pannyavaro Mahathera, Pdt. Jacky Manuputty, dan Lukman Hakim Saifuddin. (*)

Harapan Barcelona merekrut Jonathan Tah dari Bayern Munchen pada bursa transfer Januari 2027 tampaknya sulit terwujud. Klub raksasa Bundesliga itu tidak berniat melepas bek tengah Timnas Jerman tersebut karena masih menjadi bagian penting dari rencana pelatih Vincent Kompany .

Barcelona sebelumnya memasukkan Tah dalam daftar pemain incaran untuk memperkuat lini pertahanan. Pelatih Hansi Flick membutuhkan bek berpengalaman yang bisa menjadi tandem Pau Cubarsi di jantung pertahanan Blaugrana.

Tah dinilai memenuhi kriteria tersebut. Selain memiliki pengalaman panjang di Bundesliga, Flick juga mengenal kualitas sang pemain karena pernah bekerja dengannya di level klub maupun tim nasional Jerman.

Namun, ketertarikan Barcelona belum cukup untuk mengubah sikap Bayern.

Bayern Tak Ingin Kehilangan Tah

Menurut laporan jurnalis Diario Sport, Carlos Monfort, yang dikutip akun Bayern Insider @iMiaSanMia, peluang Tah meninggalkan Allianz Arena menuju Barcelona hampir tertutup.

Bayern tidak memiliki keinginan untuk menjual bek berusia 30 tahun itu, baik melalui transfer permanen maupun peminjaman. Tah sendiri juga disebut tidak sepenuhnya tertarik meninggalkan Munchen.

Persaingan di lini belakang Bayern memang cukup ketat. Kim Min-jae beberapa kali mendapat kesempatan bermain bersama Dayot Upamecano. Meski demikian, kondisi tersebut tidak mengurangi kepercayaan Kompany terhadap Tah.

Manajemen Bayern tetap menganggap pemain internasional Jerman itu sebagai bagian penting dari proyek tim.

Kontrak Tah Berlaku hingga 2029

Bayern memiliki posisi kuat dalam mempertahankan Tah karena sang pemain masih terikat kontrak hingga Juni 2029.

Tah bergabung dengan Bayern dari Bayer Leverkusen pada musim panas 2025 dengan kesepakatan berdurasi empat tahun. Kedatangannya bahkan dipercepat agar ia bisa memperkuat tim dalam ajang Piala Dunia Antarklub FIFA.

Dengan kontrak yang masih panjang dan kepercayaan pelatih, Bayern tidak melihat alasan untuk melepasnya dalam waktu dekat.

Barcelona Harus Cari Pilihan Lain

Kegagalan mendapatkan Tah membuat Barcelona perlu mempertimbangkan kandidat lain. Deco selaku direktur olahraga bersama Flick masih membutuhkan bek tengah berpengalaman untuk menambah kekuatan lini belakang.

Kondisi keuangan klub juga menjadi pertimbangan dalam menentukan target transfer. Barcelona membutuhkan pemain yang bisa langsung memberikan kontribusi tanpa membebani anggaran secara berlebihan.

Dengan sikap tegas Bayern dan minimnya keinginan Tah untuk pindah, Barcelona kemungkinan harus mengalihkan perhatian ke nama lain pada bursa transfer musim dingin. (*)

Berbelanja di supermarket mungkin menjadi aktivitas rutin yang terasa biasa. Namun, bagi sebagian orang, berjalan melewati lorong panjang dengan rak-rak tinggi, lampu terang, dan kerumunan pengunjung justru bisa memicu rasa pusing, mual, hingga kehilangan keseimbangan.

Kumpulan keluhan tersebut dikenal dengan istilah sindrom supermarket . Kondisi ini berkaitan dengan gangguan sistem keseimbangan tubuh, terutama ketika otak kesulitan mengolah berbagai rangsangan visual di lingkungan yang padat.

Meski namanya terdengar seperti penyakit tertentu, sindrom supermarket bukan diagnosis medis tersendiri. Istilah ini digunakan untuk menggambarkan gejala pusing atau ketidakstabilan yang muncul akibat rangsangan visual.

Mengapa Supermarket Bisa Memicu Pusing?

Untuk menjaga keseimbangan, otak mengandalkan informasi dari tiga sistem utama, yakni penglihatan, sistem vestibular di telinga bagian dalam, dan proprioseptif yang membantu tubuh mengenali posisi serta gerakan.

Ketiganya bekerja bersama agar seseorang bisa berdiri dan bergerak dengan stabil.

Masalah dapat muncul ketika informasi dari sistem-sistem tersebut tidak selaras. Di supermarket, misalnya, lorong panjang, rak tinggi, lampu terang, serta pergerakan orang di sekitar menghasilkan rangsangan visual yang sangat padat.

Dalam kondisi tertentu, otak terlalu mengandalkan informasi dari mata dan kurang memperhatikan sinyal keseimbangan dari telinga bagian dalam maupun tubuh. Akibatnya, seseorang bisa merasa seperti sedang bergoyang atau terombang-ambing meskipun sebenarnya berdiri diam.

Gejala yang Perlu Dikenali

Sindrom supermarket dapat menimbulkan beberapa keluhan, antara lain:

Pusing atau kepala terasa berputar.

Mual dan rasa tidak nyaman.

Tubuh terasa tidak stabil ketika berdiri atau berjalan.

Kebingungan terhadap posisi dan arah.

Sensasi seperti bergoyang meskipun tidak sedang bergerak.

Gejala tersebut dapat membuat seseorang merasa tidak nyaman ketika berada di tempat ramai. Bahkan, sebagian orang bisa mengalami kecemasan saat harus kembali mengunjungi pusat perbelanjaan.

Kapan Perlu Memeriksakan Diri?

Keluhan pusing akibat rangsangan visual juga dapat berkaitan dengan kondisi kesehatan lain, seperti persistent postural-perceptual dizziness (PPPD), gangguan telinga bagian dalam, disfungsi penglihatan binokular, hingga riwayat cedera kepala atau leher.

Salah satu cara sederhana untuk mengurangi gejala adalah memilih waktu berbelanja ketika supermarket tidak terlalu ramai. Lingkungan yang lebih tenang dapat membantu mengurangi beban rangsangan visual yang diterima otak.

Namun, jika pusing terus berulang, berlangsung lama, atau muncul tanpa penyebab yang jelas, pemeriksaan medis sangat dianjurkan.

Dokter Robert Thompson menyebut pemeriksaan diperlukan untuk mengetahui kemungkinan penyebab yang mendasari keluhan tersebut.

Jika diperlukan, pasien juga dapat menjalani terapi rehabilitasi vestibular. Terapi ini membantu melatih otak menyesuaikan kembali respons keseimbangan tubuh.

Latihannya dapat mencakup paparan bertahap terhadap lingkungan dengan rangsangan visual padat agar toleransi tubuh meningkat.

Dengan mengenali gejalanya sejak awal, seseorang dapat lebih memahami respons tubuh dan menentukan kapan perlu mencari bantuan medis. (*)

Kemenko PMK Dorong Penguatan Kerja Sama Indonesia-Australia untuk Memperkuat Ketangguhan Bencana

KEMENKO PMK -- Deputi Bidang Koordinasi Penanggulangan Bencana dan Konflik Sosial Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Kemenko PMK) Lilik Kurniawan mendorong penguatan kerja sama Indonesia–Australia di bidang penanggulangan bencana dan bantuan kemanusiaan. Kerja sama ke depan diharapkan menghasilkan program yang berkelanjutan dan menjawab kebutuhan pemerintah daerah dalam membangun ketangguhan bencana.

Hal tersebut disampaikan Lilik saat menerima audiensi Delegasi Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) Pemerintah Australia di Kemenko PMK, Jakarta, Senin (9/11/2026). Pertemuan tersebut menjadi forum konsultasi dan penjajakan desain kerja sama kedua negara untuk melanjutkan kemitraan setelah Program SIAP SIAGA.

Lilik menyampaikan apresiasi atas dukungan Pemerintah Australia selama ini, khususnya dalam peningkatan kapasitas dan penguatan sistem penanggulangan bencana. Kemitraan tersebut dinilai telah berkontribusi terhadap penguatan kesiapsiagaan dan respons bencana di Indonesia.

Salah satu bentuk dukungan yang disoroti ialah Logistics Hub di Kota Padang, Sumatera Barat. Fasilitas ini menjadi salah satu warisan penting kerja sama Indonesia–Australia dan berperan sebagai pusat koordinasi logistik, termasuk saat Indonesia menghadapi Siklon Senyar yang berdampak pada tiga provinsi. Keberadaannya membantu memperkuat pengelolaan dan distribusi dukungan logistik dalam penanganan bencana.

Dalam pertemuan tersebut, Lilik juga mengusulkan lima area prioritas pengembangan kerja sama, yakni penguatan tata kelola dan koordinasi Aksi Merespon Peringatan Dini (AMPD), pengembangan Dashboard Personal KITA TANGGUH, penguatan koordinasi penanggulangan bencana dan bantuan kemanusiaan, penguatan tata kelola kolaborasi multipihak melalui Indonesia Disaster Management Summit (IDMS), serta penguatan kapasitas koordinasi dan keberlanjutan pembangunan ketangguhan kawasan.

Lilik menegaskan, program kerja sama ke depan perlu berorientasi pada hasil dan manfaat nyata, bukan sekadar kegiatan seremonial. Dukungan yang diberikan harus mampu memperkuat kapasitas, sistem, dan mekanisme kerja yang dapat dimanfaatkan pemerintah daerah secara berkelanjutan.

"Program kerja sama ke depan harus benar-benar menjawab kebutuhan daerah dan memberikan dampak nyata dalam memperkuat ketangguhan bencana. Kita ingin memastikan bahwa setiap dukungan yang diberikan dapat menghasilkan manfaat yang berkelanjutan, bukan sekadar kegiatan seremonial," tegas Lilik.

Delegasi DFAT Pemerintah Australia yang hadir antara lain Team Leader Paul Nichols, Partnership Advisor Tanya McQueen, Counsellor Paula Gerhardt, First Secretary Kedutaan Besar Australia Jacquin Lord, DRM Specialist Avianto Amri, dan Senior Program Manager Riri Silalahi.

Melalui audiensi ini, Kemenko PMK berharap kemitraan Indonesia–Australia semakin terarah dan responsif terhadap kebutuhan. Keberlanjutan kerja sama diharapkan dapat memperkuat tata kelola penanggulangan bencana nasional sekaligus mendukung terwujudnya masyarakat Indonesia yang lebih tangguh menghadapi bencana.

Kemenko PMK Perkuat Pengurangan Risiko Bencana Zoonosis dan Penyakit Infeksius Baru melalui Surveilans Berbasis Masyarakat di DKI Jakarta

KEMENKO PMK – Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Kemenko PMK) terus memperkuat upaya pengurangan risiko bencana nonalam, khususnya ancaman zoonosis dan Penyakit Infeksius Baru (PIB), melalui pengembangan Surveilans Berbasis Masyarakat (SBM) yang diselenggarakan di Jakarta, pada Rabu-Kamis (11-12/11/2026).

Upaya ini dilakukan dengan mendorong keterlibatan aktif masyarakat dan Forum Pengurangan Risiko Bencana (PRB) dalam meningkatkan kewaspadaan dini terhadap potensi ancaman kesehatan di lingkungan sekitar.

Deputi Bidang Koordinasi Penanggulangan Bencana dan Konflik Sosial Kemenko PMK, Lilik Kurniawan, menekankan bahwa kesiapsiagaan menghadapi ancaman bencana nonalam perlu dibangun sejak dini melalui peningkatan literasi dan keterlibatan aktif masyarakat.

“Kesiapsiagaan menghadapi ancaman bencana nonalam perlu dibangun sejak dini melalui peningkatan literasi dan keterlibatan aktif masyarakat. Masyarakat perlu memiliki pengetahuan untuk mengenali potensi ancaman zoonosis dan penyakit infeksius baru, serta memahami langkah yang harus dilakukan. Dalam hal ini, Forum PRB memiliki peran penting sebagai wadah kolaborasi antara pemerintah, akademisi, organisasi kemasyarakatan, dan masyarakat dalam memperkuat kewaspadaan dini,” ujar Deputi Lilik.

Beliau juga menyoroti bahwa ancaman zoonosis dan penyakit infeksius baru tidak terlepas dari kondisi kesehatan hewan dan lingkungan. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan pendekatan kolaboratif melalui konsep One Health, yakni keterpaduan upaya menjaga kesehatan manusia, hewan, dan lingkungan secara menyeluruh.

Asisten Deputi Pengurangan Risiko Bencana Kemenko PMK Andre Notohamijoyo menambahkan bahwa dalam konteks pengurangan risiko bencana, langkah pencegahan perlu dilakukan sebelum suatu kejadian berkembang menjadi wabah. Kemampuan masyarakat untuk mengenali perubahan kondisi kesehatan manusia, hewan, maupun lingkungan serta menyampaikan informasi secara cepat dan tepat menjadi kunci dalam membangun kesiapsiagaan, ujar Asdep Andre.

Sementara itu, Kepala Pelaksana BPBD Provinsi DKI Jakarta, Marulitua Sijabat, turut menegaskan kompleksitas ibu kota sebagai kawasan metropolitan dengan kepadatan penduduk dan mobilitas masyarakat yang tinggi. Mengingat masyarakat merupakan pihak yang paling dekat dengan lingkungan tempat tinggalnya, mereka sering kali menjadi pihak pertama yang mengenali perubahan kondisi di lapangan.

“Surveilans Berbasis Masyarakat menjadi salah satu upaya strategis untuk memperkuat kewaspadaan dini. Melalui SBM, masyarakat didorong untuk mengenali, mencatat, dan meneruskan sinyal atau indikasi awal yang berpotensi menimbulkan ancaman kesehatan masyarakat,” jelas Marulitua.

Lebih lanjut, ia mengingatkan pentingnya mekanisme pelaporan yang tepat dengan tetap mengedepankan keselamatan, kerahasiaan data pribadi, serta menghindari penyebaran informasi yang belum terverifikasi.

Sebagai informasi, kegiatan ini melibatkan berbagai pemangku kepentingan di DKI Jakarta, meliputi BPBD, Dinas Kesehatan, Dinas Ketahanan Pangan, Kelautan dan Pertanian, serta Forum PRB, yang menaungi puluhan organisasi kemsyarakatan, keagamaan, dan perguruan tinggi.

Dalam implementasi SBM, para relawan dibekali lima pedoman utama, yaitu mengutamakan keselamatan, mencatat fakta dengan cepat, menggunakan jalur pelaporan resmi, memastikan konfirmasi dan tindak lanjut, serta menjaga komunikasi dan kerahasiaan data.

Mekanisme pelaporan diarahkan melalui jalur resmi, yakni indikasi kejadian kesehatan manusia diteruskan kepada Puskesmas atau fasilitas kesehatan, sedangkan kejadian kesehatan hewan dilaporkan kepada petugas kesehatan hewan atau Pusat Kesehatan Hewan (Puskeswan). Pemerintah Provinsi DKI Jakarta juga menyediakan layanan Jakarta Siaga 112 sebagai nomor tunggal panggilan darurat yang dapat diakses masyarakat secara gratis selama 24 jam dan terintegrasi dengan instansi terkait.

Asdep Andre menambahkan bahwa melalui kegiatan ini, Kemenko PMK mendorong agar penguatan SBM tidak berhenti pada peningkatan literasi dan pemahaman semata, tetapi dapat diterjemahkan menjadi rencana aksi yang konkret dan berkelanjutan di tingkat masyarakat. Sinergi lintas sektor yang terbangun diharapkan semakin memperkuat ketangguhan masyarakat dalam mengenali, melaporkan, dan mengantisipasi ancaman zoonosis serta penyakit infeksius baru sejak dini.

The BMW i3 represents a pivotal moment for Munich, successfully transitioning its iconic 3 Series into the electric era. Built on the advanced “Neue Klasse” platform, this electric sports saloon seamlessly blends luxury, high-end performance, and disruptive technology. With a jaw-dropping WLTP-certified range of up to 566 miles, the i3 comfortably outpaces established competitors like the Tesla Model 3, setting an aggressive new benchmark in the global electric vehicle (EV) market. Thew video below from Auto Trader gives us a detailed look at the new i3.

Revolutionary Range: The i3 50 xDrive packs a massive 108.7 kWh usable battery, unlocking an extraordinary class-leading WLTP range of up to 566 miles. Neue Klasse Architecture: Built on BMW’s bespoke EV foundation, featuring the ultra-responsive “Heart of Joy” driving dynamics supercomputer. Blistering DC Charging: Supports up to 400 kW DC fast charging, capable of pumping back hundreds of miles of range in roughly 21 minutes. Competitive Entry Pricing: Launches with UK pricing starting from £47,925 for the 40 xDrive, scaling up to high-performance dual-motor trims.

The BMW i3 introduces a bold, forward-looking design language that honors BMW’s heritage while rewriting the rules for modern EVs. Its front profile is defined by a reimagined kidney grille integrated cleanly into dual headlamp assemblies, animated light strips, and sharp daytime running lights (DRLs). Aerodynamics dictate the taut sheet metal, with flush pocket-style door handles and an extended wheelbase maximizing both high-speed efficiency and interior legroom.

At the rear, clean horizontal lighting elements and a sculpted stance emphasize width. Practicality hasn’t been sacrificed for style either, offering a deep 450-liter boot complemented by a useful front trunk (frunk) for cable storage.

Inside, the cabin embodies BMW’s commitment to minimalist luxury. High-grade sustainable materials, clean horizontal lines, and ambient lighting create an inviting lounge-like atmosphere. Spanning the base of the windscreen is the groundbreaking BMW Panoramic Vision display, working alongside a 3D Head-Up Display to project driver-focused data cleanly across the cockpit.

At the heart of the i3’s cabin experience is an AI-powered personal assistant integrated with advanced cloud intelligence, allowing for natural, conversational voice commands to manage climate, navigation, and media. Native streaming apps and seamless smartphone replication ensure your digital life travels with you effortlessly.

Everyday ergonomics are addressed with clever touches, including wireless device charging trays, multiple high-speed USB-C ports, and modular storage compartments. The stretched wheelbase of the Neue Klasse platform guarantees that rear passengers enjoy adult-friendly knee and headroom, cementing the i3 as a true long-distance cruiser.

The flagship i3 50 xDrive features a robust 108.7 kWh usable battery pack paired with dual electric motors generating a mighty 463 horsepower (345 kW) and 476 lb-ft (645 Nm) of torque. This setup rockets the saloon from 0 to 62 mph in a brisk 4.7 seconds.

Driving dynamics are governed by BMW’s proprietary “Heart of Joy” controller, which unifies powertrain and chassis behavior with microsecond precision. The result is an exceptionally agile saloon that hides its battery weight masterfully, offering razor-sharp steering feedback, flat cornering, and progressive regenerative braking that maximizes energy recapture during daily commutes.

Long-distance anxiety is effectively dismantled by the i3’s 800V electrical architecture supporting up to 400 kW DC fast charging. When hooked up to an ultra-rapid charger, the vehicle can replenish its battery from 10% to 80% in just 21 minutes, or inject hundreds of miles of range in the time it takes to grab a coffee.

Furthermore, bidirectional charging capabilities (V2G and V2H) allow the car to feed electricity back into your home grid or power external appliances, making the i3 an active energy node rather than just a vehicle.

In the UK market, the BMW i3 lineup kicks off with the i3 40 xDrive starting at £47,925, while the long-range 50 xDrive and sportier M Sport trims span up to £57,425 before options.

When stacked against competitors like the Tesla Model 3, Hyundai Ioniq 6, and Audi A6 e-tron, the BMW i3 decisively wins the battery-range race while undercutting traditional luxury German rivals on operating costs—benefiting greatly from low company car tax brackets.

The BMW i3 successfully redefines what an electric sports saloon can achieve, fusing category-leading range, futuristic interior packaging, and classic BMW driving engagement. Whether your main criteria are long-distance touring, uncompromised cabin technology, or raw electrical efficiency, the new i3 delivers a comprehensive package that alters the landscape of the premium EV segment.

Samsung’s Galaxy S27 series introduces a new “Pro” model, designed to bridge the gap between the S27+ and the flagship S27 Ultra. While the Pro aims to offer a balance between affordability and premium features, its compromises in key areas such as camera and processor technology raise questions about its overall value. For a device marketed as “Pro,” these trade-offs may leave consumers questioning whether it truly lives up to its name.

New Lineup Tier: The Galaxy S27 Pro slots between the traditional Plus model and the top-tier Ultra as a mid-sized “mini-Ultra” alternative. Telephoto Controversy: While retaining a 200MP main sensor, leaks indicate it relies on an older 10MP 3x telephoto module, lagging behind modern flagship standards. Processor Scaling: Equipped with the standard Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 rather than the high-binned Extreme variant reserved for the Ultra. Aggressive Production Bet: Samsung is reportedly allocating over 70% of its upcoming flagship production volume exclusively to the Pro and Ultra models.

The Galaxy S27 series consists of four models: the S27, S27+, S27 Pro, and S27 Ultra. The addition of the Pro model is intended to fill the gap between the mid-tier S27+ and the high-end Ultra, offering consumers a middle-ground option. However, this positioning comes with its own set of challenges.

Samsung offers five distinct color options across the lineup: navy, white, light blue, pink, and burgundy. Among these, burgundy is highlighted as the “hero” color for the Pro and Ultra models, emphasizing their premium appeal. This approach aligns with Samsung’s tradition of using standout colors to differentiate its flagship devices and create a sense of exclusivity.

The Pro model’s pricing strategy places it just $100 above the S27+, making it an attractive option for those looking to upgrade without committing to the Ultra’s higher price tag. However, this pricing decision also raises expectations for the Pro to deliver features that justify its “Pro” branding.

The Galaxy S27 Ultra sets a high standard with its advanced camera system, designed to cater to users who prioritize photography and videography. It features upgraded sensors for its main, ultra-wide, and telephoto cameras, along with a redesigned square front camera. These enhancements ensure top-tier performance in various lighting conditions and scenarios.

In contrast, the S27 Pro shares some of the Ultra’s features, such as the 200MP main camera, ultra-wide camera and front camera. However, its telephoto capabilities fall short. The Pro is equipped with an older 10MP 3x telephoto camera featuring a smaller sensor, which is a noticeable downgrade compared to the Ultra’s innovative telephoto system. This decision significantly impacts the Pro’s ability to deliver high-quality zoom and low-light performance, two areas where flagship devices are expected to excel.

The Pro’s telephoto sensor is not only smaller than that of the Ultra but also lags behind competitors like the Pixel 11 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro, both of which feature larger telephoto sensors. Even more strikingly, the Pro’s telephoto sensor is smaller than the one found in the Galaxy Note 8, a device released nearly a decade ago in 2017. This raises concerns about whether the Pro can meet the expectations of users who prioritize camera performance in a premium device.

The performance gap between the Pro and Ultra models is further highlighted by their processor technology. The Galaxy S27 Pro is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, a capable chipset that handles most tasks efficiently. However, it falls short when compared to the Snapdragon 8 Extreme Gen 6 found in the Ultra.

This distinction underscores the Ultra’s position as the true flagship model, offering superior performance for demanding activities such as gaming, multitasking and AI-driven features. For consumers who prioritize top-tier performance, the Pro’s processor may feel like a compromise, especially given its $1300 price tag. This price point places the Pro in direct competition with other flagship devices that offer more powerful hardware.

Samsung’s production strategy for the Galaxy S27 series reflects its focus on the Pro and Ultra models. The company plans to allocate over 70% of production to these two variants, with a target of producing 18 million Ultra units and 7–8 million Pro units. By pricing the Pro just slightly above the S27+, Samsung aims to encourage upgrades while maintaining a clear distinction between the Pro and Ultra.

However, this strategy is not without risks. The Pro’s compromises in camera and processor technology may not justify its price for many consumers. For a device marketed as “Pro,” these shortcomings could lead to disappointment, especially when competitors offer superior hardware at similar price points. The Pro risks being perceived as a device that sacrifices too much to fit its intended market position.

The Galaxy S27 Pro has faced criticism for its telephoto camera, which is seen as a significant downgrade for a device carrying the “Pro” label. The smaller sensor limits its zoom capabilities and reduces its effectiveness in low-light conditions, two areas where flagship devices are expected to excel. For a device priced at $1300, these shortcomings are difficult to overlook, particularly when competitors like Google and Apple offer more advanced camera systems in their similarly priced models.

Additionally, the Pro’s processor, while competent, does not match the power and efficiency of the Ultra’s Snapdragon 8 Extreme Gen 6. This further diminishes the Pro’s appeal, especially for consumers who prioritize performance and expect a “Pro” device to deliver innovative technology. At its price point, the Pro may struggle to justify its position in the lineup, leaving consumers to question whether it offers enough value to warrant its cost.

Samsung’s introduction of the Galaxy S27 Pro reflects its ambition to diversify its flagship lineup and appeal to a broader range of consumers. However, the Pro’s compromises in key areas such as camera and processor technology raise questions about its ability to deliver on its “Pro” branding.

While the Pro may attract users seeking a middle ground between the S27+ and Ultra, its shortcomings could limit its success in a highly competitive market. For consumers who prioritize performance, camera quality and overall value, the Ultra remains the clear choice in the Galaxy S27 series. The Pro, despite its positioning, may struggle to carve out a distinct identity that resonates with its target audience.

Wearable devices have become essential for tracking heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) during sleep, with Garmin and Fitbit emerging as leaders in this space. Garmin models like the Fenix 9 Pro demonstrated low mean absolute error (MAE), with deviations rarely exceeding 2 BPM, while Fitbit devices excelled in correlation, closely mirroring reference trends. These findings were benchmarked against the Polar H10 ECG chest strap, a gold standard for HR and HRV tracking, according to The Quantified Scientist.

Explore how Garmin’s precision in MAE and Fitbit’s strength in trend correlation cater to different user needs. You’ll also gain insight into the limitations of devices like the Apple Watch and Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2, particularly in HRV accuracy. This breakdown provides a clear comparison to help you identify which wearables align best with your sleep and recovery tracking goals.

Garmin devices, such as the Garmin Circa and Fenix 9 Pro, demonstrated strong accuracy in heart rate tracking during sleep, with mean absolute error (MAE) as low as 0.7 BPM and deviations rarely exceeding 2 BPM. Fitbit devices, including the Fitbit Edge and Charge 6, excelled in correlation with reference data but struggled with very low heart rates, slightly overestimating values below 38 BPM. The Apple Watch and Amazfit Helio Strap showed mixed accuracy, with the Apple Watch exhibiting variability in heart rate readings and the Amazfit Helio Strap often detecting heart rates that were too high. HRV tracking revealed strengths and limitations: Garmin devices excelled in MAE, while Fitbit devices led in correlation. The Garmin Fenix 9 Pro effectively identified HRV trends, and the Fitbit Charge 6 showed good correlation but underestimated HRV in higher ranges. Challenges in wrist-based HR and HRV tracking persist due to poor signal quality, but advancements in wearable technology have significantly improved accuracy compared to devices from five to ten years ago.

Garmin and Fitbit devices have emerged as leaders in tracking heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) during sleep. Various wearables were evaluated against the Polar H10 ECG chest strap, a widely recognized gold standard for HR and HRV tracking. The Polar H10, used by companies like Apple and Google, measures the heart’s electrical activity with high precision, making it an ideal reference for assessing wearable accuracy.

Garmin devices, such as the Garmin Circa and Garmin Fenix 9 Pro, excelled in mean absolute error (MAE), which quantifies the average difference between a wearable’s readings and the reference device. The Garmin Circa showed an average error of approximately 0.7 BPM, with deviations typically ranging from 1 to 2 BPM and a maximum deviation of about 7 BPM.

Similarly, the Fenix 9 Pro delivered consistent results, with most data points closely aligning with the reference and deviations rarely exceeding 2 BPM. These results highlight Garmin’s reliability for heart rate tracking during sleep.

The Fenix 9 Pro also performed well in identifying HRV trends, effectively distinguishing the highest and lowest HRV nights. Minor deviations were noted, with slightly higher values in lower HRV ranges and slightly lower values in higher ranges. Comparable trends were observed in the Garmin Forerunner 170.

However, Fitbit devices struggled with very low heart rates. On a night when the reference device recorded heart rates as low as 35 BPM, the Fitbit Air and Edge reported no values below 38 BPM, slightly overestimating heart rates below this threshold. While this limitation is unlikely to affect most users, it could be significant for individuals with unusually low resting heart rates. It is unclear whether this issue stems from hardcoded constraints or insufficient low-heart-rate examples in Fitbit’s model.

The Fitbit Charge 6, described as an older device, showed strong correlation for HRV but tended to detect slightly lower HRV values in higher ranges. Despite this, Fitbit devices generally outperformed Garmin in correlation for both HR and HRV.

The Apple Watch exhibited greater variability in heart rate readings compared to Garmin and Fitbit. It occasionally recorded heart rates that were too high or too low, with some peaks potentially caused by export artifacts. Similarly, the Amazfit Helio Strap struggled with accuracy, often detecting heart rates that were too high, as shown by pronounced peaks in its data. These discrepancies may result from calculating maximum heart rate in a given area rather than the average.

The Eight Sleep mattress could detect low heart rates but cannot measure heart rate when the user is out of bed, a limitation not shared by the reference device. Meanwhile, the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 performed well for heart rate tracking, detecting resting heart rates of 43 BPM on a low night and 48 BPM on a higher night. However, its HRV data was deemed unreliable due to implausibly poor results.

In HRV tracking, Garmin and Fitbit devices excelled in different areas. Garmin devices performed strongly in mean absolute error, while Fitbit devices led in correlation. For instance, the Fitbit Charge 6 showed good correlation but tended to underestimate HRV values in higher ranges. Conversely, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 achieved a very good mean absolute error but lagged in correlation.

The Garmin Fenix 9 Pro and Forerunner 170 displayed minor deviations in HRV detection, with slightly higher values in lower HRV ranges and slightly lower values in higher ranges. Despite these deviations, the Fenix 9 Pro effectively identified trends, such as the highest and lowest HRV nights.

The Pivot Air, tested on the biceps, demonstrated both a low mean absolute error and high correlation but exhibited a systematic bias. Nevertheless, it provided useful insights for identifying high and low HRV nights.

Other devices, such as the HD Pod 6 and Polar Loop, performed well but did not match the accuracy of Garmin and Fitbit. For example, the HD Pod 6 came close to Garmin’s performance but fell slightly short. The Polar Loop, tested on the biceps, delivered acceptable heart rate results but was less impressive for HRV based on mean absolute error. Similarly, the Fitbit Air, also tested on the biceps, was adequate for heart rate but underwhelming for HRV.

The Luna Band performed well for resting heart rate but requires improvement overall. Meanwhile, the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 excelled in heart rate tracking but fell short in HRV accuracy. Devices outside the top-performing group, such as the Amazfit Helio Strap, exhibited issues with either correlation or mean absolute error.

The evaluation highlighted the challenges of measuring HR and HRV on the wrist, a location with poor signal quality. Accurately detecting individual distances between heartbeats is more difficult on the wrist compared to other body locations. Despite these challenges, the tested devices showed significant advancements over technology from five to ten years ago.

Most devices are assumed to calculate average heart rate over five-minute intervals unless otherwise specified. While the host continues to refine their code and filtering methods, these adjustments may lead to updates in their findings. For most users, the average heart rate and HRV data provided by these devices are likely sufficient.

When considering both HR and HRV tracking, Garmin devices stood out for their low mean absolute error, while Fitbit devices excelled in correlation. Other devices, such as the HD Pod 6, performed well but did not reach the same level of accuracy. Devices like the Luna Band showed promise for resting heart rate but require further refinement.

The Quantified Scientist highlights Garmin devices as strong performers in mean absolute error for both heart rate and HRV, while Fitbit devices excel in correlation, particularly for trend detection. The HD Pod 6 and Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 showed good results for heart rate but fell short in other areas, such as HRV accuracy. While all tested devices provide adequate average heart rate and HRV data for most users, those prioritizing specific metrics may find Garmin or Fitbit to be the better choice depending on their needs.

Smart locks like the Smonet AH1 and GHome KD10SE2 offer compelling features at the competitive price of $119, but their differences cater to distinct user preferences. Meanwhile, the GHome KD10SE2 focuses on practicality, featuring a rechargeable 10,000 mAh battery and easy installation, according to Smart Home 101.

Explore how these locks compare in key areas, from build quality and security features to smart integrations and maintenance. This breakdown will help you decide which smart lock aligns best with your priorities and daily needs.

The Smonet AH1 features a premium zinc alloy build, has passed a 72-hour salt spray test, and was tested for 400,000 cycles, but it only supports single-cylinder doors and lacks compatibility with mortise locks. The Smonet AH1 supports Apple Home Key, allowing unlocking with an iPhone or Apple Watch, but its functionality is split between two apps, which may require adaptation and has untested long-term reliability for Home Key. The GHome KD10SE2 lacks Apple Home Key but provides a robust app with features like access history logs, temporary passcode generation, and power-saving mode, making it ideal for users prioritizing monitoring and customization. The Smonet AH1 uses replaceable batteries with a Type-C emergency charging port, while the GHome KD10SE2’s rechargeable battery lasts up to 10 months, reducing maintenance and waste.

If you’re considering a smart lock with a budget of $119, the Smonet AH1 and GHome KD10SE2 are two notable options. Both include fingerprint scanners, keypads, built-in Wi-Fi, and physical key backups, but they cater to different priorities. Here’s a detailed comparison to help you decide which lock suits your needs.

The Smonet AH1 stands out with its premium zinc alloy construction. It has passed a rigorous 72-hour salt spray test and was tested for 400,000 cycles, according to the manufacturer. Its modern design earned the American Good Design Award in 2025. However, it is only compatible with single-cylinder doors between 1 and 3/8 to 2 and 1/8 inches thick and does not support mortise locks.

The GHome KD10SE2 focuses on practicality. It fits standard door cutouts without requiring additional drilling, simplifying installation. While its design is less aesthetic, it offers functional advantages, such as a removable 10,000 mAh battery rechargeable via USB-C without detaching the lock. The package includes a key fob, screws, keys, and a deadbolt, covering all setup and usage needs.

The Smonet AH1 offers the most access methods: fingerprint, keypad, proximity key cards, mechanical keys, and Apple Home Key. Proximity key cards allow unlocking with a single tap. During testing, the fingerprint setup required a second attempt initially but worked smoothly afterward. The auto-lock feature is present but may need user adjustments, as it did not relock immediately during testing.

The GHome KD10SE2 provides access via fingerprint, passcode, app, and physical key. Its fingerprint reader is responsive, unlocking in about a second, and the backlit keypad ensures usability in low light. However, the keypad’s tight spacing caused occasional input errors during testing. Unlike the Smonet, it lacks key cards, which could be inconvenient for users with guests or children.

The Smonet AH1 is particularly appealing to Apple users due to its Apple Home Key integration, allowing the lock to open when an iPhone or Apple Watch is nearby, even with a depleted battery. It also supports Apple Home, Alexa, and Google Assistant, though remote control requires a HomePod or Apple TV. Siri can unlock the door but requires Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode for security.

However, its functionality is split between two apps: Apple Home for Home Key and Siri, and Smonet Security for fingerprint management and alerts. This dual-app setup may take time to adapt to, and the long-term reliability of Home Key remains untested with extended daily use.

The GHome KD10SE2 lacks Apple Home Key but compensates with a robust app offering detailed control. Features include charging and lock status, access history logs, temporary passcode generation, scheduling, auto-lock delay, and a power-saving mode. These features make it a strong choice for users prioritizing monitoring and customization.

The GHome KD10SE2 features a rechargeable 10,000 mAh battery rated for up to 10 months of use. Low battery alerts appear on both the lock and the app, and the battery can be recharged without removing the lock. This design reduces maintenance and waste, offering a more convenient solution for users who prefer to avoid frequent battery changes.

Both locks emphasize security but take different approaches. The Smonet AH1 features a durable build with 2,000 Newtons of pressure resistance. It also comes with a 30-day return policy, a 12-month warranty, and lifetime support.

The GHome KD10SE2 enhances security with anti-pry protection, a temporary lockout after repeated incorrect code entries, and an anti-peep code function. The anti-peep feature allows entering random digits before or after the actual code, preventing onlookers from deducing the correct combination. This feature proved practical during testing.

Your choice between the Smonet AH1 and GHome KD10SE2 depends on your priorities. The Smonet AH1 is an excellent option for Apple users, offering integration with Apple Home Key and multiple access methods. However, its reliance on replaceable batteries and the need to manage two apps may be less convenient for some.

The GHome KD10SE2 is better suited for those valuing reliability and low maintenance. Its rechargeable battery, detailed app functionality, and practical security features make it a strong contender for everyday use. While it lacks Apple Home Key support, this may not matter to users outside the Apple ecosystem.

Both locks offer excellent value at the same price, but their distinct features cater to different needs. Apple users may prefer the Smonet AH1, while those seeking a hassle-free, reliable solution are likely to favor the GHome KD10SE2.

Your iPhone does listen to you, but not in the way many fear. While rumors about apps secretly recording conversations for targeted advertising persist, the reality is more nuanced. Your device’s microphone is primarily used for specific functions, such as activating Siri or allowing voice commands. Targeted ads, on the other hand, are largely driven by your online activity rather than covert eavesdropping. By understanding how your iPhone uses its microphone and collects data, you can take proactive steps to safeguard your privacy and maintain control over your personal information. The video below from Proper Honest Tech gives us more details.

No Eavesdropping Ads: Studies and security audits confirm apps do not covertly stream ambient voice logs to build ad profiles; digital footprints drive recommendations. Always-On Voice Triggers: Hardware-level low-power processors continuously listen strictly for activation phrases like “Siri” or “Hey Siri”. Visual Indicator Dots: An active orange status dot in your Dynamic Island or status bar explicitly reveals when the microphone is engaged. Privacy Hardening: Users can disable ambient listening toggles, restrict third-party mic permissions, and opt out of cross-app tracking in iOS settings.

Siri, Apple’s voice assistant, is designed to respond to designated wake phrases. This feature relies on a specialized low-power acoustic buffer chip that continuously monitors the immediate environment for the spoken command. While this functionality enhances hands-free convenience, it can occasionally lead to accidental activations triggered by similar phonetic sounds, resulting in brief unintended audio buffers.

If you are strictly concerned about privacy regarding voice assistant recording retention, you can modify your device configurations:

By making these adjustments, you ensure Siri activates exclusively via manual physical inputs, giving you absolute command over your device’s audio hardware.

Your iPhone provides clear hardware-backed visual indicators whenever device sensors are engaged. An orange dot illuminates in the status bar whenever any software process utilizes the microphone, while a green dot signals active camera usage. These visual cues operate at the system kernel level, meaning malicious apps cannot bypass or mask them.

Additionally, the App Privacy Report in iOS settings logs detailed 7-day micro-behavioral histories for sensor and network access. While fears of apps recording private conversations for targeted marketing remain widespread, cybersecurity audits consistently show no evidence supporting continuous audio harvesting. Apps request microphone access for functional utilities such as voice messaging, VoIP calls, and dictation.

The eerily personalized ads you encounter across social media and web browsers are powered by your comprehensive digital footprint rather than ambient microphone monitoring. Data brokers, advertising networks, and platform ecosystems (such as Meta and Google) track your cross-site browsing history, search queries, location metadata, and app interaction habits to build behavioral profiles.

To minimize algorithmic profiling and restrict targeted tracking:

Taking control of your data security requires auditing built-in system parameters. Apple provides native tools to lock down sensitive hardware channels:

Even with robust tracking protections enabled, targeted advertisements often feel unnervingly coincidental. This phenomenon is driven by the “frequency illusion” (or Baader-Meinhof phenomenon) combined with sophisticated algorithmic probability forecasting. When you think about purchasing a specific item, your brain subconsciously highlights related advertisements that were already being served to your demographic profile, leading to the false impression that your phone listened to your conversation.

Your iPhone is not covertly streaming your private conversations to ad agencies, but active voice assistants and app permission structures demand mindful management. By adjusting your system configurations, reviewing sensor indicators, and limiting tracking tokens, you can maintain absolute transparency and security over your personal data.

How Siri Listens, and What You Can Do About It Disable Always-On Voice Recognition in your iPhone Siri settings to stop continuous keyword monitoring. Adjust analytical sharing permissions to prevent audio samples from being stored or reviewed for service improvements. How Apps Use Your Microphone Regularly audit app permissions for microphone and speech recognition under your privacy settings. Revoke background microphone permissions for any application that does not require it for active operation. Targeted Ads: The Role of Your Digital Activity Disable “Allow Apps to Request to Track” globally within your iOS Privacy & Security menu. Turn off “Apple Advertising Personalized Ads” to restrict device-level identifier ad matching. Manage off-platform tracking permissions directly inside third-party social media account settings. Privacy Settings to Strengthen Your Security Turn off “Improve Siri and Dictation” data-sharing preferences. Restrict background microphone and speech parsing permissions for non-essential apps. Check the App Privacy Report periodically to inspect background sensor calls. Opt out of cross-app data sharing networks. Smart glasses are evolving quickly, and the latest entries from Google and Ray-Ban Meta offer distinct approaches to wearable tech. Google’s glasses, developed with Samsung and designed by Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, start at $395 and integrate deeply with the Google ecosystem, including apps like Gmail and Maps. In contrast, Ray-Ban Meta’s Gen 3 glasses, priced at $449, emphasize broader compatibility and features like live streaming and offline translation, as explored by Tech Court.

Dive into this explainer to understand how these models compare in key areas like battery life, camera performance, and software integration. You’ll gain insight into Google’s ecosystem-focused design, including its Android-exclusive features, and Meta’s global availability and social media integration. Whether you’re prioritizing compatibility, functionality, or price, this breakdown will help clarify which smart glasses align best with your needs.

Google’s new smart glasses, priced at $395, are lighter and offer double the storage (64 GB) compared to the $449 Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3, but Meta’s glasses include six microphones for better noise reduction and a charging case with up to 50 extra hours of battery life. Google’s glasses integrate with its ecosystem, featuring the Gemini assistant for tasks like navigation, translation in over 70 languages, and visual input, though some features are Android-only at launch and testing revealed occasional inaccuracies. Meta’s glasses support a wider range of devices, including iPhones and Android phones, and are available globally, while Google’s glasses are limited to Pixel 7 or newer and select Galaxy phones, launching only in the US and South Korea on December 10, 2026. Privacy concerns differ: Google’s glasses blur faces and include a physical switch to disable smart functions, but the recording light does not activate during visual input. Meta’s glasses disable recording if the light is blocked but may use shared photos to improve its AI. Meta offers more options, including the $379 Gen 2 for a budget-friendly choice, the $449 Gen 3 with incremental upgrades, and a $799 display model, while Google’s display glasses remain in testing with no release date.

Ray-Ban’s smart glasses have been a popular choice for wearable tech that resembles traditional eyewear. This week, Google entered the market with its own smart glasses, developed with Samsung and designed by Warby Parker and Gentle Monster. Priced at $395, Google’s glasses are less expensive than the $449 Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3. While both models share core features, they differ in compatibility, regional availability, and functionality.

Both models feature a 12-megapixel camera, open-ear speakers for calls and music, and an IPX4 rating, making them resistant to sweat and light rain but unsuitable for swimming. Neither includes a display, requiring users to rely on their phones for visual content. Battery life is rated at nine hours for both, though Meta’s glasses reportedly drain faster with heavy camera use.

Video recording capabilities show slight differences. Meta Gen 3 records in 3K resolution, while Google’s glasses also list 3K but have produced shorter 2K clips in some tests. Google’s glasses are lighter at 41 g, compared to Meta Gen 3’s 52 g, which may be noticeable during extended wear. Storage also differs: Google offers 64 GB, double Meta’s 32 GB.

However, Meta includes six microphones that claim to reduce over 90% of background noise during calls, compared to Google’s four microphones. Meta’s charging case provides up to 50 extra hours of battery life, while Google’s case supports seven full charges but is heavier, weighing 167 g for Warby Parker frames and 194 g for Gentle Monster frames.

Become an expert in Google and Meta smart glasses with the help of our in-depth articles and helpful guides.

Google’s glasses integrate closely with its ecosystem. The Gemini assistant supports Google Calendar, Gmail, and Maps, allowing users to manage schedules, respond to messages, and navigate without their phones. Gemini also offers visual input features like identifying bus schedules or posters and supports translation in over 70 languages via the Translate app. However, some features, such as Guided Vision for blind and low-vision users, are Android-only at launch.

In testing, Gemini occasionally required explicit prompts to use the camera and once provided incorrect information about a bird until corrected. Another reviewer noted that Gemini could rejoin a conversation if its response was repeated aloud. The gesture to summon Gemini, a double pinch from the wrist, works with a Pixel Watch but not with an Apple Watch.

Meta’s glasses excel in compatibility and availability. They support iPhones running iOS 17 or newer and Android devices on Android 10 or later, and they are available globally. Live translation works offline once a language pack is downloaded, and sharing to Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger is built-in. Meta’s glasses also support live streaming, a feature blocked by app store rules on Google’s glasses. Additionally, Meta includes a new action button for quick access to Meta AI.

Privacy features vary between the two models. Google’s glasses include a white light to indicate recording, blur faces before processing images, and have a physical switch to disable smart functions. However, the recording light remains off when Gemini uses the camera for visual input, raising concerns. Google states that images are not saved or used for training or ads, though text chats with Gemini are stored in the user’s history.

Meta’s glasses disable recording if the light is blocked, but the company has acknowledged that photos shared with its AI may be used to improve the system. This, combined with Meta’s association with a social media company, could make some users uncomfortable in public or private settings. Samsung has stated that recording on its glasses stops when they are removed.

Google’s glasses are designed primarily for its ecosystem, supporting Pixel 7 and newer devices, as well as recent Galaxy phones running One UI 9. They do not support Motorola, OnePlus, Xiaomi, or Samsung’s A series phones at launch. iPhone compatibility is unclear, with conflicting reports on whether the cutoff is the iPhone 13 Pro or newer, or the iPhone 13 with 6 GB of RAM.

Additionally, Google’s glasses are launching only in the US and South Korea, with shipments beginning on December 10, 2026. Users must have an adult Google account registered in one of these regions to activate the glasses.

In contrast, Meta’s glasses are already available globally and support a broader range of devices. With three generations of development, they offer a more refined product compared to Google’s first-generation release.

Meta’s Gen 3 glasses are the most expensive in this category at $449, $70 more than the Gen 2, which costs $379. The Gen 3 adds an extra hour of battery life, a slimmer frame, an action button, and improved microphones but retains the same camera as the Gen 2.

For users uninterested in photo or video capabilities, Meta offers the Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses at $349, which include open-ear speakers and the assistant. Meta’s higher-end display model starts at $799 and offers around six hours of use.

Google’s Warby Parker frames start at $395, placing them between Meta’s Gen 2 and Gen 3 in price. Gentle Monster frames for Google’s glasses range from $449 to $489. Both brands offer prescription lens options, which can significantly increase costs.

Warby Parker supports prescriptions from minus 8 to plus 5, while Gentle Monster accommodates up to minus 9 on some frames, though these orders are final sale. Adding prescription or light-responsive lenses to Google’s glasses can push the total well above $395.

Choosing between Google and Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses depends on your phone, location, and priorities. Google’s glasses are ideal for users with a Pixel 7 or newer, or a Galaxy running One UI 9, who live in the US or South Korea and rely heavily on Google apps. However, their limited compatibility, regional restrictions, and lack of independent reviews make them a riskier investment.

Meta’s glasses are better suited for users with other phones, those outside the US or South Korea, or anyone seeking a proven product available now. The Gen 2 at $379 offers a more affordable option, while the Gen 3 provides incremental upgrades for those willing to spend more. For users seeking a display in the lens, Meta’s higher-end model starts at $799, while Google’s display glasses remain in testing with no release date.

Tech Court concludes that the choice between Google and Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses hinges on your phone, location, and priorities. Google’s glasses are a better fit for Pixel 7 or Galaxy users in the US or South Korea who rely on Google apps, but their limited compatibility and lack of independent reviews make them a cautious buy. Meta’s glasses, with broader compatibility and global availability, are the safer option for most users today. For iPhone owners, waiting for real buyer feedback is advisable.

The Apple HomeView is a sleek and compact smart home hub designed to integrate seamlessly into the Apple ecosystem. Featuring a 7-inch screen, it combines smart home control, multimedia playback, and personal assistant capabilities in one device. While it excels in areas such as responsive controls and AirPlay integration, it falls short in app functionality and customization, leaving room for improvement. The video below from Stephen Robles explores its design, features, and limitations to help you determine if it’s the right addition to your home.

Compact Square Display: Features a 7-inch Liquid Retina square touch canvas (1088×1088 resolution) engineered with ultra-low 0.3-nit nightstand dimming. A18-Powered Intelligence: Driven by the A18 chip supporting multi-user face and voice recognition for up to six household members. Ecosystem Integration: Functions as an intuitive HomeKit and Matter smart display hub with AirPlay multi-room audio and FaceTime capabilities. App Ecosystem Limits: Operates without a standalone App Store, relying instead on native system apps and shared casting capabilities.

The Apple HomeView embodies Apple’s signature minimalist design philosophy. Its compact form factor, featuring a 7-inch square Liquid Retina display (1088×1088 resolution) perched on a domed speaker base via a flexible stainless steel hinge, makes it a versatile addition to any space—whether on a desk, kitchen countertop, or nightstand. The adjustable tilt mechanism ensures an optimal viewing angle whether you’re managing smart home routines or using it as a digital photo frame.

Powered via a USB-C port, the countertop model packs robust audio hardware including two custom full-range drivers and a down-firing woofer with passive radiators, offering sound quality well above its diminutive footprint. Wall-mounted versions are also available, though dedicated mounting brackets and power kits are sold separately.

Setting up the HomeView is a straightforward process executed directly through a nearby iPhone or iPad, cementing its place within Apple’s hardware ecosystem. Once configured, the device uses facial and voice recognition backed by the A18 chip’s secure enclave to deliver private, personalized content for up to six distinct users. This ensures individual access to personal calendars, reminders, and media playlists without exposing private data to other household members.
